findings.claim: The official README explicitly offers a CPU-only environment; a GPU is faster, not an absolute training requirement.
The reference notebook trains a U-Net on randomized patch splits with TverskyLoss; this is not the requested buffered whole-segment hide-and-recover design.
The notebook writes a single-band GeoTIFF using label-grid CRS and transform. That example alone does not validate range, registry uniqueness or portal approval.
